target: Original North American PSP release via PPSSPP on PC; PS2 port excluded

areas.name: Run Setup
areas.location_cue: The title screen, PPSSPP profile, and first normal save.
areas.note: The original North American PSP release is the content authority; the later PlayStation 2 port is comparison-only.

levels.1: Keep the handheld release as the rules authority.
levels.2: Run a verified personal PSP dump through PPSSPP.
levels.3: Use the original North American PSP release with a dedicated PPSSPP profile. Controller remapping and resolution scaling are safe; avoid cheats that alter evidence, career totals, timers, damage, or inventory.

levels.1: Protect the profile before long cleanup sessions.
levels.2: Maintain an ordinary PSP save plus rotating backup states.
levels.3: Confirm the in-game save reloads, then back up the PPSSPP save directory before emulator changes. Use states only as temporary recovery points; the normal PSP save should remain the completion record.

levels.1: Do not mix data from the later altered port.
levels.2: Use PSP mechanics and unlock conditions throughout.
levels.3: The 2010 PlayStation 2 edition is outside this route. Its changes do not replace PSP evidence, career, training, bonus, or multiplayer records.

levels.1: A finished operation can be revisited.
levels.2: Use Mission Mode for every missed pickup or failed condition.
levels.3: Cleared operations become individually replayable. Alert checks, armor restrictions, timed searches, fragile hazards, and automatic awards can all be retried, so no single-player record is permanently missable.

levels.1: Both story settings open different bonus content.
levels.2: Finish Story Mode once on Normal and once on Hard.
levels.3: Complete both difficulty routes. The Normal clear opens Behind the Scenes; the Hard clear opens Shadowed. Use Hard while building the Sharpshooter career meter, because its qualifying precision kills are difficulty-gated.

areas.name: Training
areas.location_cue: The five practice courses available from the single-player menu.
areas.note: Course 5 contains one practice evidence; it does not contribute to a Locked File.

levels.1: Speed matters in the opening drill.
levels.2: Finish the first course in less than 1 minute 30 seconds.
levels.3: Run the first course cleanly and stop the clock below 1:30 to unlock the SP-57. Restart immediately after a missed movement or shot cycle.

levels.1: Keep the second course moving.
levels.2: Finish the second course in less than 3 minutes.
levels.3: Clear every required station and reach the finish below 3:00 to unlock the FAMAS. Prioritize clean transitions over searching the practice space.

levels.1: Accuracy is the entire test.
levels.2: Complete the third course without wasting a shot.
levels.3: Hit every required target with no miss and no unnecessary round fired. A perfect attempt unlocks the UNP .45; restart as soon as a shot fails to count.

levels.1: Practice the advanced combat controls.
levels.2: Complete every station in the fourth course.
levels.3: Perform each prompted advanced-combat action and cross the finish trigger. This course has no separate weapon reward, but it counts toward the all-training bonus gate.

levels.1: Finish the underwater-control course.
levels.2: Complete every station in the fifth course.
levels.3: Follow the underwater prompts through the entire course and reach its completion trigger. Collect the practice evidence in the first pool during the same visit.

levels.1: Inspect the first pool before leaving it.
levels.2: At the foot of the ramp in the first training pool.
levels.3: Enter the first pool, swim to the base of its exit ramp, and collect the practice evidence before climbing out.

levels.1: Complete the full training menu.
levels.2: Finish all five training courses.
levels.3: Record a clear on Courses 1 through 5. The full set unlocks Lian's First Time; the three performance weapons remain separate conditions.
